en: Sepia-toned historical street scene showing a wide unpaved main street lined with low houses and shops. On the left, a half-timbered building houses a confectionery shop, and beside it stands a larger corner house with a shop front bearing the name "Heinrich Noack". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and a man rides a bicycle. The caption at the top reads "Coswig i. S. Hauptstraße." and a small red imprint at the bottom names the publisher.
